title_en: Supreme People's Court's Decision on Commending the Ten Outstanding Female Judges of the Nation (Summary)
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Decision on Commending Ten National Outstanding Female Judges (Summary)

Fa [1999] No. 17

Among the ranks of courts nationwide, there are over 28,000 female judges. They have diligently studied Deng Xiaoping Theory, upheld the Party's fundamental principle of serving the people wholeheartedly, earnestly fulfilled the sacred duties entrusted by the Constitution and laws, cherished the cause of adjudication, strictly enforced the law, handled cases impartially, maintained integrity and self-discipline, and made selfless contributions. They have strived to uphold judicial justice, made outstanding contributions to the development of socialist democracy and the improvement of the socialist legal system, and have produced a large number of advanced models, fully demonstrating the spirit and demeanor of female judges in People's Courts in the new era. To commend their exemplary deeds, the Supreme People's Court has decided to confer the title of "Ten National Outstanding Female Judges" upon Comrades Shang Xiuyun and nine others.

The Supreme People's Court calls upon all judges and other staff in courts nationwide to learn from the commended female judges. Learn from their noble sentiment of serving the people wholeheartedly; learn from their professional ethics of impartial law enforcement, integrity, and incorruptibility; learn from their dedication to duty and diligent work ethic; learn from their modest, prudent, and enthusiastic service-oriented judicial style. Strive to fully implement the spirit of the Fifteenth National Congress of the Communist Party of China, realize the basic strategy of "governing the country according to law and building a socialist country ruled by law," advance court reform, uphold judicial justice, improve judicial efficiency, strengthen the construction of the People's Court team, and establish a positive image of the People's Courts. It is hoped that the commended female judges will continue to make persistent efforts, guard against arrogance and rashness, maintain their honor, carry it forward, and achieve new accomplishments.

February 10, 1999

Appendix:

List of Ten National Outstanding Female Judges

Shang Xiuyun, Judge of the Second Criminal Adjudication Tribunal of Haidian District People's Court, Beijing

Gao Binghuan, Judge of the Execution Tribunal of Tongzhou District People's Court, Beijing

Qin Lingmei, Judge of the First Economic Adjudication Tribunal of Xuhui District People's Court, Shanghai

Yue Lu, Assistant Judge of the First Economic Adjudication Tribunal of Panjin Intermediate People's Court, Liaoning Province

Liu Liping, Deputy Chief Judge of the Filing Division of Yanbian Korean Autonomous Prefecture Intermediate People's Court, Jilin Province

Dai Fei, Chief Judge of Linhuai People's Tribunal of Xuyi County People's Court, Jiangsu Province

Zhu Xiaomei, President of Lucheng District People's Court, Wenzhou, Zhejiang Province

Tang Zhaohua, President of Zongyang County People's Court, Anhui Province

Zhao Xiaoli, Judge of the First Criminal Adjudication Tribunal of Guangdong High People's Court

Yang Yinghong, Chief Judge of the Civil Adjudication Tribunal of Diecai District People's Court, Guilin, Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region
